SkateBIRD

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Buy Now$19.99 USD or more

(does not include a Steam key - if you want that, go buy it on Steam, thanks!)

(this is v2.0, the newest version, same as you'd see on other platforms, just DRM free)

You're a lonely lil' bird, and your Big Friend has hung up their board for good. Their job sucks, and lately, they're barely ever home to play with you. You're gonna fix all that with the power of being a chill little skateboarding bird. You may be tiny, but the more you skate, the more following you get, the more the world of bird skating will open up. Birds will come check out your park, help you find more parks, and together you'll (somehow) fix Big Friend's life! Above all else, skate birds try their best.

  • Explore lots of bird-sized parks, with simple controls familiar to any pro skating tiny hawk.
  • Find fancy clothing, secret mixtapes of new music, birbs that need your help, and more!
  • Skate to an original low-fi birb-hop soundtrack!

And if you bail, you just get back up - because above all else, skate birbs try their best!

SteamDeck-Specific Instructions:

If you're trying to run this on a SteamDeck via the Itch client, you may find the Linux version doesn't work.  AJ Venter (thanks!) sez: "mono libraries fail to load. These are likely not available on steamOS."

They also say the Itch version will work  fine regardless, BUT: you need to install the windows version and use Force Compatibility mode to make it use Proton 8.

(and if anyone finds out more, do tell- it's weird that it doesn't work on SteamOS Linux, but works fine on, you know, any other Linux box)

aaaand that's about it so:

<play the trailer up top to make music for this dancing birb>

Just wanted to say the Linux version runs great on my Steam Deck! I didn't get any missing library issue. I think the mono library in question might be related to Unity's C# integration, so it could be that they tried to run a debug executable (which are still in the project's root folder) which might've tried to generate the C# symbols using the mono lib. If they didn't have that on their system, then that would explain its failure. There's a bit of an issue with the controller glyphs not showing up for my 8bitdo controller and the button to bind the menu controls yields a blank list, but all-in-all pretty minor stuff, as the game runs smoothly, looks great, and is fun so far!

TheOddOnion4 years ago (1 edit)

This game was a blast throughout. As the game progresses, levels get harder, but you will become better with time. This element of improvement is the best part of the game, as visible improvement makes our brains go whoo. My least favourite stage would have to be the rooftop due to the lack of control of your speed which makes grinds harder, and my favourite stage would have to be the first one, in the room, its perfection. At times, the game's comedy seems off but at others, it's hilarious and surprising.  My only criticism/feedback would be that there is now way to roll? Idk yaw roll or other one. One of the most critical is missing.  The music is in all honesty a hit or miss very few tracks spoke to me so I just use Spotify. My advice? Buy the game, put on some chill music, then vibe out for a couple of hours.

 Overall a good fun time: 12/16
